# DLSSNR-AMD: the menus' texts in English (NR Control and the ReShade Add-ons page).
# This file is made from the program at every build and replaced by every install: do not translate it
# here. Copy it to a file of your own in this folder (README.txt says how) and translate that one.

msgid "@language"
msgstr "English"

# A font file for the letters of your language (in this folder, or a full path); empty: NR Control's own,
# which has Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters only.

msgstr ""

msgid "[Network] Resize History. Only when NR runs before the upscaler and the game changes its render size\n(dynamic resolution):\nOff (default): NR's previous result is dropped and NR starts again at the new size, as NVIDIA's DLL does.\nOn: the previous result is scaled to the new size and kept. Steadier on our tests when the size changes\noften, but not what NVIDIA's DLL does. Games with jittered input (most DLSS games) hide most of the\nrestart, so the default is off."
msgstr "[Network] Resize History. Only when NR runs before the upscaler and the game changes its render size\n(dynamic resolution):\nOff (default): NR's previous result is dropped and NR starts again at the new size, as NVIDIA's DLL does.\nOn: the previous result is scaled to the new size and kept. Steadier on our tests when the size changes\noften, but not what NVIDIA's DLL does. Games with jittered input (most DLSS games) hide most of the\nrestart, so the default is off."

msgid "[Network] Model. CC_SMALL_FP8: 310.9.16's default network. CC_SMALL_FP8_EXPERIMENTAL: ours, CC_SMALL_FP8 made faster. CC_SILVER_AARDWOLD: 310.8.0's network (310.9.16's preset 1). CC_SILVER_AARDWOLD_INT4_MIXED: that network with part of its arithmetic in int4, faster, a slightly different picture. Switching builds the new network in the background; the running one serves until it is ready."
msgstr "[Network] Model. CC_SMALL_FP8: 310.9.16's default network. CC_SMALL_FP8_EXPERIMENTAL: ours, CC_SMALL_FP8 made faster. CC_SILVER_AARDWOLD: 310.8.0's network (310.9.16's preset 1). CC_SILVER_AARDWOLD_INT4_MIXED: that network with part of its arithmetic in int4, faster, a slightly different picture. Switching builds the new network in the background; the running one serves until it is ready."

msgid "auto"
msgstr "auto"

msgid "resident"
msgstr "resident"

msgid "offload"
msgstr "offload"

msgid "minimal"
msgstr "minimal"

msgid "[Network] Residency: what is kept of a network not in use. The networks share one activation memory, so mostly their weights. auto (default): the weights stay in video memory, switching back is quick; moved to RAM when video memory runs short, freed when RAM does too. resident: kept whole, switching back is instant, the most video memory. offload: the weights in RAM, all video memory freed. minimal: everything freed, switching back builds anew. While the other network gets ready, the running one keeps serving. NR off for 10 s: offload and minimal do the same to the running network, auto only when video memory is short."
msgstr "[Network] Residency: what is kept of a network not in use. The networks share one activation memory, so mostly their weights. auto (default): the weights stay in video memory, switching back is quick; moved to RAM when video memory runs short, freed when RAM does too. resident: kept whole, switching back is instant, the most video memory. offload: the weights in RAM, all video memory freed. minimal: everything freed, switching back builds anew. While the other network gets ready, the running one keeps serving. NR off for 10 s: offload and minimal do the same to the running network, auto only when video memory is short."
